headline: Premier League today: How to watch, TV channels & live stream
body: How will Chelsea and Manchester United fare today? Here is what to know, including kick-off time, TV channels and live stream options Chelsea and Manchester United both need a response to recent bad results. The former suffered a penalty shootout Carabao Cup exit to Liverpool on Wednesday days after a dismal home defeat to Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League. The latter, meanwhile, have endured a chaotic week despite not playing a match. Michael Carrick is still in place as United manager despite widespread belief that Sunday’s 3-0 loss to Bournemouth would be his final act. Continue reading...
